Render the SPECIFIC scene below, with large clear subjects and a purposeful camera view. Upper 25–30 percent should be visually quiet so the separately typeset headline can be placed there; stage the actual objects and people prominently in the remaining area. The scene must carry the story; never substitute generic abstract cards, charts, floating app UI, or an anonymous cashier portrait. Cobalt-blue details connect the brand while other scene colors remain natural. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, readable receipts, signage, A/B/C graphics, infographic panels, price typography, or actual app screenshots. Unbranded screens and tags remain blank. Fictional illustrative art, not a real merchant photo or testimonial.
Style: Rich editorial watercolor and gouache with fine pencil detail, warm human observation, tactile paper grain, sophisticated controlled colors.
Color direction: sage, cobalt, paper ivory.
Specific scene: Painterly gouache vignette of a small cafe owner changing just one shelf display while the rest of the shop stays orderly. Owner has moved one pastry stand nearer the counter and pauses to observe the doorway. Cozy shop plants, restrained brush texture, side-on medium-wide composition, calm thoughtful atmosphere, no charts or diagram boxes.
